source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    divider_color = grid[0][divider]
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != divider_color]
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][divider] = divider_color
    left_side = max(c for r, c, v in points) < divider
    if left_side:
        shift = divider - 1 - max(c for r, c, v in points)
        marker_col = min(c for r, c, v in points) + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = divider + 1 - min(c for r, c, v in points)
        marker_col = max(c for r, c, v in points) + shift + 1
    for r, c, v in points:
        out[r][c + shift] = v
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][marker_col] = 8
    return out
'''
